title: DaySmart | 9 Grooming Products for Your Salon Goals

facts.fact: The article presents a guide to nine leading grooming products for pet salons.
facts.quote: We’ve compiled a guide to the 9 leading grooming products you need to avoid losing clientele

facts.fact: DaySmart's vendor page offers a free trial of DaySmart Pet software, described as 'absolutely free'.
The vendor's sales phone number listed on the page is +1 (877) 849-5602.
The article's call to action refers to reaching salon goals for the year 2018.
facts.quote: to find out more about the right grooming products to help you to take your pet salon to the next level in 2018
